metadata.description:
In this week's Tribal Bulletin, we dive into the ongoing political drama over Dhangad/Dhargar reservation in Maharashtra, where both JMM and BJP are fiercely competing for the tribal vote bank. As tribal identity becomes a key electoral issue, the reservation debate is heating up ahead of the upcoming elections.
In Manipur, the situation remains tense as tribal communities continue to express their concerns over the ongoing conflict and its impact on their rights and livelihoods. We also bring you the latest from Assam, where Bodo rice beer and several other indigenous products have been granted the prestigious Geographical Indication (GI) tag, marking a significant step in recognizing and preserving the rich cultural heritage of the state's tribal communities.

Stay tuned for in-depth coverage of these crucial developments shaping the tribal landscape.
